# Logger

A logger over any writer: levels, context fields and timestamps.

<h2 id="logger"><code>Logger</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Logger {
    // private fields
}
```

Writes records at or above a level to a stream, each as one write. Not copied.
A logging call never fails: the first failure to write is kept for [`Failure`](/docs/api/log/logger#failure) to report, and the records after it
are still attempted. A logger is used by one thread at a time; the process-wide functions such as [`Info`](/docs/api/log/logger#info) are the
ones to share between threads.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Logger.rux#L13)

**Associated functions**

<h3 id="new"><code>New</code></h3>

```rux
pub func New(
    allocator: Allocator,
    sink: Writer,
    format: LogFormat
) -> Logger
```

A logger writing records in `format` to `sink`, at level [`Info`](/docs/api/log/logger#info) and above, with times.

| Name        | Type        | Description                                       |
| ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what each record is built in before it is written |
| `sink`      | `Writer`    | where the records go                              |
| `format`    | `LogFormat` | how they are written                              |

**Returns**: the logger

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Logger.rux#L32)

<h3 id="enabled"><code>Enabled</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Enabled(self: &Logger, level: Level) -> bool
```

Whether a record at `level` would be written, by this logger's level and the build's [`CompiledLevel`](/docs/api/log/level#compiled-level). Worth
asking before working out fields that cost something to compute.

| Name    | Type    | Description            |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------- |
| `level` | `Level` | the level to ask about |

**Returns**: whether it would be written

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Logger.rux#L63)

<h3 id="set-timestamps"><code>SetTimestamps</code></h3>

```rux
pub func SetTimestamps(self: &var Logger, enabled: bool)
```

Whether records start with the time. Leaving it out suits a destination that adds its own, such as a service
manager's journal.

| Name      | Type   | Description               |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------- |
| `enabled` | `bool` | whether to write the time |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Logger.rux#L71)
